svg.title: The Four Archival Stages
svg.desc: A technical schematic of the archival pipeline: 01 Acquisition of primary artifacts, 02 High-fidelity non-destructive digitisation, 03 Dual-pass transcription and verification, and 04 Granular segment indexing with immutable evidence locators.
